mapper.sql: id, shop_id, from_status, to_status, operator_id, remark, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop_apply_log (shop_id, from_status, to_status, operator_id, remark, created_at) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operatorId}, #{remark}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM shop_apply_log WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT FROM shop_apply_log WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND to_status = 'REJECTED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_apply_log WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND to_status = 'PENDING'
